script_text: Stop! Aquarius, the stars are screaming at you right now. Venus is conjunct your ruling planet Uranus in Gemini, igniting your 5th House of romance and creative spark, while Jupiter in Leo trines Saturn in Aries across your 7th and 3rd Houses of partnerships and communication. As an Air sign, you feel the electric shift in your bones, and Pluto’s steady presence in your 1st House of identity grounds this chaos into lasting change. If single, this conjunction attracts an unconventional soul who challenges your intellect; if taken, break routine with a spontaneous adventure to reignite flames. Careerwise, the Jupiter-Saturn trine opens a lucrative writing or negotiation deal—check your 3rd House email before noon for a proposal that boosts income. Blessing: a sudden financial gift from a fellow Aquarius friend lands in your account by dusk. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
